about.heading: One person, the whole delivery
about.lead: Where I started, what I build, and how a system gets from a requirement to a handoff.
about.n1: I build custom business systems — CRM, ERP, e-commerce, and compliance and financial platforms — for companies in retail, education and professional services.
about.n2: I started as an IT assistant at a logistics and customs-brokerage company, working on their internal systems. That is where I learned SQL, PHP, Firebird and Laravel.
about.n3: I founded Voltz Agency, where I personally develop the company's flagship systems end to end. I also take on select freelance projects directly.
about.n4: I own the full delivery process: requirements and system architecture, AI-accelerated development across front end and back end, and hands-on refinement — security, edge cases and finalization — before every handoff. I hold a certification in prompt engineering.
about.n5: I built my own automated auditing tool to test delivered systems end to end.

volare.name: Volare Company
volare.summary: Advisory for Brazilian public tenders: automated search across the PNCP, continuous monitoring of tender notices, and compliance with Law 14.133/2021.
volare.shotAlt: The Volare Company home page, presenting its public tender advisory service.
volare.context: Volare Company advises businesses that sell to the Brazilian public sector. Every opportunity begins as a tender notice published on the PNCP — the federal government's public procurement portal — and each one has to be read against Law 14.133/2021, the Brazilian public procurement act, before a company commits to bidding.
volare.challenge: Finding the relevant notices on the PNCP, and keeping track of the ones already in play, was work done by hand, notice by notice. The platform had to automate that search, keep watching the notices as they change, and hold the requirements of Law 14.133/2021 alongside each one.

delivered.d1: Automated search across the PNCP, the Brazilian government's public procurement portal.
delivered.d3: Compliance with Law 14.133/2021 built into the way notices are handled.
delivered.d4: Architecture, front end, back end, hardening and handoff — developed by me alone, 100%.

volare.result: The platform launched recently and is still in early use, so there are no result figures to report — and none have been invented here. What it changes today is qualitative: a search that used to be run by hand now runs automatically, and notices are watched continuously instead of being checked one at a time.

voltz-hub.name: Voltz Hub
voltz-hub.summary: Voltz Agency's own product for running tasks and projects — designed, built and released by me as the agency's founder.
voltz-hub.shotAlt: The Voltz Hub home page, presenting its task and project management product.
voltz-hub.context: Voltz Hub is Voltz Agency's own product. I founded Voltz, and I developed Voltz Hub end to end, alone — which means the requirements came from inside the company rather than from a client brief.
voltz-hub.challenge: Task management and project management had to work as one product, not as two sets of screens that happen to share a login. That meant a single data model behind both, an interface fast enough to work inside all day, and state that stays legible as work moves.

delivered.d1: Task management and project management as one product.
delivered.d2: React and Vite front end, with Framer Motion carrying the interface motion.
delivered.d3: Supabase as the data, authentication and API layer.
delivered.d4: Architecture, front end, back end, hardening and release — developed by me alone, 100%.

blumenns.name: Blumenns
blumenns.summary: A semi-jewelry store — 925 silver and 18k gold plating — with an authenticated admin panel for managing the catalogue.
blumenns.shotAlt: The Blumenns home page, presenting its semi-jewelry collection.
blumenns.context: Blumenns sells semi-jewelry: 925 sterling silver with 18k gold plating. The build is two products in one — a storefront where the pieces are presented, and an authenticated admin panel where the catalogue is maintained from inside the store instead of through a developer.
blumenns.challenge: One person had to build and secure both halves: a storefront that does the pieces justice, and an admin area behind authentication where products are created and edited without touching code.

delivered.d1: Storefront for the 925 silver and 18k gold-plated catalogue.
delivered.d2: Authenticated admin panel for product management.
delivered.d3: React and Vite across both the storefront and the admin panel.
delivered.d4: Architecture, build, hardening and handoff — developed by me alone, 100%.
